claims.text: Prompt engineering provides lightweight improvements for mitigating bias and hallucinations in healthcare LLMs.
The mitigation effectiveness of prompt engineering in healthcare LLMs is highly dependent on prompt design.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation consistently enhances factual grounding in healthcare LLMs.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation increases computational cost in healthcare LLMs.
Model Context Protocol enables dynamic knowledge integration in healthcare LLMs.

evidence.description: Results show that prompt engineering provides lightweight improvements
Prompt engineering is highly dependent on prompt design
RAG consistently enhances factual grounding though at increased computational cost
MCP emerges as a promising but underexplored tool for dynamic knowledge integration

methodologies.name: Systematic Literature Review and Thematic Analysis
methodologies.description: Synthesizes 34 eligible peer-reviewed studies published between 2021 and 2025 focused on mitigating bias and hallucinations in healthcare LLMs.

limitations.text: Absence of unified frameworks for mitigating bias and hallucinations in healthcare LLMs.
Limited evidence on healthcare-specific prompt design.
Lack of practical deployment guidelines for LLMs in clinical settings.

future_work.text: Development of unified mitigation frameworks for bias and hallucinations in healthcare LLMs.
Exploration and evidence gathering on healthcare-specific prompt design.
Establishing practical deployment guidelines for healthcare LLMs in clinical settings.
